question: List the names of all students.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students AS s;

question: Show each student name with the title of the course they enrolled in.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, c.title FROM students AS s JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.id;

question: How many students are in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(s.id) AS student_count FROM departments AS d JOIN students AS s ON s.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name;

question: List the students who are enrolled in a course worth more than 3 credits.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollments AS e WHERE e.student_id = s.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM courses AS c WHERE c.id = e.course_id AND c.credits > 3));

question: Which instructor teaches the Databases course?
gold_sql: SELECT i.name FROM instructors AS i JOIN course_offerings AS o ON o.instructor_id = i.id JOIN courses AS c ON c.id = o.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Databases';
